(2) A sharp 'ding' SFX sounds, followed by a child's hesitant humming. (3) The child begins listing words with a playful, high-pitched tone, each word punctuated by a soft 'pop' SFX. (4) Another 'ding' SFX transitions to a different child who says 'shut up' with a mischievous chuckle. (5) A higher-pitched 'ding' introduces a third child who speaks a full sentence in English with high vocal energy. (6) A cartoonish 'thinking' sound effect (clock ticking style) accompanies the final child's silence, followed by her soft-spoken 'I don't know' and ending with bright laughter.
